releases.notes:
Minecraft 26.3 development playtest, version **2.0.12+mc26.3**, for both editions. Enable only one JAR at a time. Older Minecraft releases are unchanged.

Rot Client+ adds **AirJump** (JumpFreely, DoubleJump, GhostBlock) and extends **AutoTool** with optional main-inventory scanning and varied delays. Inventory mode uses one normal number-key swap per continuous mining session with empty-cursor, menu, equip-controller and ownership guards. Switch Back restores selection only; moved tools stay in the hotbar. AirJump affects local jump/collision handling without editing world blocks or other entities. Search `autism` in Plus; all nine adapted modules default off.

Lite has **84** catalog parents and remains **MIT**. The combined Plus edition has **145** parents and is **GPL-3.0-only**, with full upstream credits, GPL and original MIT notices. Corresponding modified sources, resources and build scripts are available through this tag's source archives. Official AUTISM source is pinned to cb6910b424f8b101b918c822ab66e865c58567cb.

Validation: **2,536 shared +394 Plus tests**, no failures/errors/skips, Java25 build, both edition verifiers and GitHub PR checks pass. Vanilla and installed Lithium collision bytecode inspected. **Minecraft gameplay, server acceptance/correction and FPS remain pending**; tests do not apply mixins in a running game. Lite is **not yet ready for public Modrinth/CurseForge publication** under the existing release audit.

Download the two playable JARs and verify SHA256SUMS.txt. Nine AUTISM module surfaces are adapted; 13 existing Rot bases still need parity review and 54 other modules are unported. The command/macro engines remain separate work.

[Manual checklist](https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/docs/AUTISM_MOVEMENT_2026-10-17.md) · [Full feature inventory](https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/docs/reports/AUTISM_CLIENT_INVENTORY.md) · [License/source provenance](https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/THIRD_PARTY.md)

releases.notes:
Minecraft 26.3 development playtest, version **2.0.11+mc26.3**. Enable only one edition and install the matching Fabric API/Java 25 requirements.

Plus adds eight opt-in AUTISM utility adapters: **SafeWalk, Parkour, Sneak, NoInteract, AutoTool (Hotbar), AutoSign, FreeLook and AirPlace**. All start disabled and unbound. Manual tool changes cancel ownership; market sign entry and Free Camera take precedence; placement work is bounded and server-confirmed state stays authoritative. Shared dashboard fixes accept long lists/macros and display fractional slider steps.

**Licenses:** Lite and original Rot source remain **MIT**. The combined Plus distribution is **GPL-3.0-only**, with full GPL text, original MIT notice, upstream credits and source hashes bundled. The modified implementation, resources and Gradle build scripts are available in this release's GitHub source archives and Git tag. AUTISM implementation and GPL notice resources are absent from Lite.

Validation: **2,536 shared + 382 Plus tests**, zero failures/errors/skips; Java 25 clean build, verifyLegitJar and verifyDungeonJarBoundary pass. No new Minecraft gameplay/FPS pass is claimed. AutoTool is hotbar-only; the other 68 builtin modules and separate command/macro systems are not complete ports. Existing dungeon/mining/session and buy-only market checkpoints are preserved.

Read [settings and manual tests](https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/docs/AUTISM_PORT_2026-10-16.md) and the [76-module inventory](https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/docs/reports/AUTISM_CLIENT_INVENTORY.md). Lite public Modrinth/CurseForge review remains open. Older Minecraft releases are unchanged.

Download the matching playable JAR below and verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Source/dev JARs are not playable downloads.

releases.notes:
Minecraft26.3 development playtest: Rot Client Lite and Rot Client+2.0.10.

Both editions fix dashboard typing/focus, clipped or buried settings panels,
long drawer scrolling/group search and Viewmodel equip/swing controls. Shared
price tooltip identity handles Special pets and verified bait icons. Plus has
a clearer explicit-target buy-only market workspace, protected Purse spending,
saved receipt and exact ownership confirmation, optional Buy done HUD and
bounded continuous scanning. Items remain for manual sale.

Validation: Java25 clean build, 2,533 shared +364 Plus tests, no failures,
errors/skips; both edition/JAR verifiers pass. Latest relevant upstream changes
and five public Hypixelv2 resources were checked. Install one edition only.

Manual gates: both-edition UI/Viewmodel controls, same-scene frame times,
small authorized test-server BIN/Bazaar transactions, cancellation/restart and
manual review. Wider gameplay, Party Finder backend/schema and public Lite
Modrinth/CurseForge release/provenance checks remain pending.

Source pins and checklist:

releases.notes:
Simon could truncate playback at dark gaps or consume locally predicted button power, while TP Maze inferred links from arbitrary movement. This change uses ordered server observations, verified maze frames and teleport/yaw evidence, with current-context checks for existing Plus automation.

World scans now run in bounded slices, map terrain is reused until its pixels/floor/identity change, and player markers remain live. Diorite/door rendering reuses cached positions; raw chunk states keep the glass display out of room hashes. All new dungeon implementations remain Plus-only, with upstream provenance and packaged notices retained.

Validation: Java 25 build; 2,520 shared +345 Plus tests (zero failures/errors/skips); both edition verifiers and diff check. Gameplay, actual FPS gains, Party Finder backend/schema and wider dungeon solver validation remain pending. See docs/DUNGEON_SCANS_2026-10-12.md for source pins, operation limits and manual checks.

releases.notes:
Rot Client and Rot Client+ 2.0.8+mc26.3 development playtest.

Plus now uses Noamm's pinned 140-room modern dataset and matching block-name hash, complete-shape room rotations, observed secret item pickups/bat deaths and server room action-bar totals. Global party increments and disappearance no longer credit or hide the wrong secret. Three Weirdos uses exact NPC speech and the rotated chest offset.

Validation: 2,519 shared + 301 Plus tests, Java25 build, verifyLegitJar and verifyDungeonJarBoundary. New implementation/data stay Plus-only; prior shared dashboard, mining, market and F7 changes are retained. Source pins and full third-party notices are included.

Download one edition and verify SHA256SUMS.txt. Minecraft 26.3, Java25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API 0.160.5+26.3 are required. Enable only one Rot edition. Gameplay remains pending; this is not a Modrinth/CurseForge public release.

Test: rotated line/L/2x2 rooms, chest/item/essence/redstone-key/bat waypoints, two players in different rooms, chunk unload/reload, rejoin, Entrance/F1-F7/Master controls and all Weirdos rotations. Party Finder's old SkyCrypt stats route/schema, Simon/TP Maze transitions and current conditional boss durations remain open.

Details: https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/blob/port/26.3/docs/DUNGEON_ROOMS_2026-10-12.md
Merged change: https://github.com/rot-tools/Rot-Client/pull/76

Older 26.1.2/26.2 downloads remain unchanged; active maintenance is 26.3 only.
